modules.name: Network Manager & Diagnostics
modules.description: Adapter IPv4/DHCP/DNS provisioning, Ping, Traceroute, Port Tester, Wi-Fi RSSI, and Routing Table.

modules.name: Tasks, Services & Ports
modules.description: Live processes, Windows services health inspector, and open TCP/UDP listening sockets.

modules.name: UltimaDiagX (Crash & Event Analyzer)
modules.description: Windows Event Logs, BSOD/crash dump analysis, error code translator, and diagnostic reports.

modules.name: GitHub Manager
modules.description: Local Git workspace launcher (VS Code/Terminal), clone your GitHub repos or any URL, and manage GitHub Releases.

modules.name: Jira Manager
modules.description: Sign in to Jira Cloud or Data Center to view assigned tasks, transition workflows, comment, log time, and create issues.

modules.name: WSL Manager
modules.description: Windows Subsystem for Linux distros, online catalog, import/export, VHDX compaction, and .wslconfig.

modules.name: Docker & Local Dev Services
modules.description: Manage Docker/Podman containers, live logs, image/volume prune, port cross-links, and local dev services.

modules.name: SSH Hosts & Certificate Inspector
modules.description: Visual ~/.ssh/config launcher, SSH key manager & generator, and expiring Windows TLS/code-signing certificate auditor.

modules.name: Multi-PC / Homelab Monitor
modules.description: Monitor secondary desktops, servers, or NAS devices via SSH, WinRM, or HTTP/ICMP probes from one dashboard.

modules.name: Smart Alerts & Watchdog Rules
modules.description: User-defined thermal, storage, network, and service watchdog rules firing native Windows toast alerts and auto-actions.

modules.name: Unified Update Center
modules.description: Unified scan of WinGet upgrades, Windows Updates, PowerShell/runtimes, and CoreWatch self-updates with pin/ignore list.

modules.name: System Snapshots & Diff
modules.description: Capture Restore Points + lightweight system state snapshots and diff Before vs. After (apps, startup, services, drivers, hosts, network).

modules.name: Backup & Folder Sync Manager
modules.description: Scheduled robocopy incremental/mirror backups to USB or NAS shares with dry-run previews, ignore patterns, and run history.

modules.name: Battery & Wireless Peripherals
modules.description: Laptop battery design vs. actual capacity, cycle count, SleepStudy reports, and live Bluetooth peripheral battery levels.

modules.name: Security & Repair Toolkit
modules.description: BitLocker, TPM, RDP, Hosts/Proxy/Env audit, DISM/SFC repairs, and 1-click IT Support ZIP.

modules.name: System Profiles & Modes
modules.description: One-click system modes (Work, Gaming, Streaming, Night & custom) controlling DnD, Power Plan, Keep Awake, Night Light & Display.

modules.name: Startup Apps Manager
modules.description: Inspect, toggle, add, or remove Windows boot registry and Startup folder entries.

modules.name: SMB Sharing Center
modules.description: Manage Windows SMB network shares and folder permissions.

modules.name: Installed Apps & App Mover
modules.description: Software inventory, folder size calculator, uninstall/modify controls, and cross-drive App Mover.

modules.name: App Installer & Launcher
modules.description: Curated software catalog, WinGet search, batch installs, bulk upgrades, and direct app launching.

modules.name: Disk Map (Visual Treemap)
modules.description: Multithreaded WizTree-style visual storage treemap, largest files, and extension breakdown.

modules.name: Devices & Drivers Tree
modules.description: Hardware device tree, driver age/version inspector, enable/disable/restart, and official driver links.

modules.name: File Organizer
modules.description: Rule-based automated file sorting with dry-run preview and 1-click undo.

modules.name: RGB Lighting Studio (RustCoreWatch Exclusive)
modules.description: Standalone native RGB controller (USB HID · NVIDIA NVAPI · PawnIO SMBus · Win11 Dynamic Lighting) with Live Thermal Reactive, Theme Accent Sync, and System Profile presets.

modules.name: Thermal & Cooling Lab (Temps, AIO/Pump & Fan Health)
modules.description: System-wide CPU/GPU/VRM/NVMe/AIO coolant telemetry, manual PWM & custom fan curves, and automated fan bearing wear / pump stall & cavitation diagnostics.
